The '''Battle of Ord Trasi''' was a battle that took place during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Trasi/Legends|Ord Trasi]]. The [[Isila Drutch's father|father]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Isila Drutch]] fought in this battle and later told his daughter about it.<ref name="TEGtW" />
